entities.summary: Jeffrey James Frazee is an American former professional ice hockey goaltender. He played college hockey for the Minnesota Golden Gophers and was drafted in the second round of the 2005 NHL entry draft by the New Jersey Devils of the National Hockey League (NHL). He played one game for the Devils during the 2012–13 season.
